introduction.p: Consider the recurrence relation a_n = a_{n-1} + 9\text{.}

statement.p: Find the first five terms of the sequence defined by the recurrence relation and initial condition a_0 = 16\text{.}
Find the closed formula for the sequence defined by the recurrence relation and initial condition a_0 = 16\text{.}
Find the first five terms of another sequence, also defined by the same recurrence relation but this time with initial condition a_0 = 3\text{.}
Find the closed formula for this second sequence.
